data.title: The Farmhouses
data.about:
Damac farmhouses offer 5 and 6 bedroom country homes in either European or North American architectural styles. This is a fantastic example of luxury country life in a bustling area. Located near major road networks and attractions, Damac Hills 2 has a strategic location.

Huge bedrooms in a separate connected wing, spacious porches surrounding the main entry, and living areas around the main entry are all available. Take a walk in nature and leave the concrete jungle behind to hear the birds and smell the flowers again. There are endless options available here. With adorable farm animals, engaging activities, and a swimming pool, you can transform your house into a world-class resort or wonderful staycation destination.

location_tile.title: Look Forward To More At Damac Hills 2
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description: The strategic position of Damac Hills 2 offers easy access to four main roads and other networks that keep the city within easy reach. In 25 minutes, take Al Qudra Road to the Damac Hills 2 gate. With its rich nature, wholesome experiences, and facilities to fulfill your every need, it is only a short drive from the city center.
